content: I followed these directions exactly to include "verify the routing against the reference image".  This required changing the PTFE tube from my original build to drop underneath the cable bundle as shown.  After I got everything re-assembled, I looked at assembly guide for the new Core One+ Gen 2 kit, and step 6.42 shows the PTFE routed the way I had it originally.  Which one is correct?

replies.content:
On my machine the tube sits on top of the cable alle the way.
I'm not going to change that for now.
